_about: T212 PROPOSALS, NOT CURATED DATA (pipeline/tools/audit/tidal_candidates.py). One row per named stream the owner's edited DFO tidal polygon (bc_fisheries_data.gpkg layer tidal_boundary) crosses, plus every named ocean-entering FWA blue line. `proposed` is where a tidal split would go (blk + FWA route measure + lon/lat on the FWA line), labelled 'mouth (tidal boundary)'; `proposed.reuse` names a curated split within 25 m on the same line that the proposal aliases 'tidal boundary' instead of a new cut; `polygon` is the polygon's own crossing; `sources` are the words that name a tidal boundary, each located on the line when it can be and said to agree (within 300 m) or not. The curation review's Tidal mode shows these; accepting one makes a mark — never a splits.json edit.

web.marker: Tidal water boundary = straight line across the Skeena from Mowitch Point (north bank) to 'Vietch Point' (south bank) as coordinated in SOR/2007-77. It sits ~5.3 km above the BCGNIS Skeena mouth point (straight-line ~6.2 km from the FWA mouth, consistent with the polygon's 6422 m crossing), ~3.5-4 km BELOW Port Essington / the Ecstall mouth, and ~19 km east of Kitson Island. Everything above it (Ecstall, Khyex, Scotia, Kwinitsa, Kasiks, Exchamsiks, Gitnadoix, Lakelse, Zymagotitz...) is freshwater for licensing even though the river is physically tidal to ~Kasiks.

endpoint_sources.Mowitch Point: SOR/2007-77 Subarea 4-15 '54°10.151′N 130°01.773′W [Mowitch Point]' = [-130.02955, 54.16918]; BC Geographical Names Mowitch Point [-130.02806, 54.16917] and OSM [-130.02955, 54.16928] agree within 100 m.
endpoint_sources.Vietch (Veitch) Point marker: SOR/2007-77 '54°08.601′N 130°00.617′W [Vietch Point]' = [-130.01028, 54.14335]. NOTE the official BCGNIS Veitch Point is at [-130.05222, 54.14861], ~2.8 km WEST of this; the archived SOR/82-215 says the boundary goes to 'a marker approximately one and one half miles easterly of Vietch Point, thence across the Skeena River to a marker near Mowitch Point' - 1.5 nmi east of BCGNIS Veitch Point is exactly the SOR/2007-77 coordinate. Use the regulation coordinate (line runs ~N-S across the river), not the named point.

The whole estuary landward (west) of the line is freshwater for licensing; the line sits ~0.6 km SEAWARD of the FWA mouth [-123.6363, 48.7532], so the polygon's 950 m of tidal water up the river is on the wrong side of it.

endpoint_sources.Hecate Boat Ramp: DFO tidal Area 18 page (Cowichan Bay halibut closure) gives the ramp verbatim as '48°44.518' N and 123°37.475' W' = [-123.62458, 48.74197]; OSM Hecate Park centroid [-123.62765, 48.74296] agrees within ~250 m. HIGH precision.
endpoint_sources.Green Point: Not in BC Geographical Names or the Canadian Geographical Names DB (no Green Point near Cowichan Bay). Located via Green Point Rd: the CVRD Area D zoning map labels 'GREEN PT. RD.' running down to a small headland at the NW shore of Cowichan Bay's head; BC Address Geocoder puts 'Green Point Rd, Duncan' at [-123.63091, 48.76659]. The point is where that road meets the shore; treat as ±300 m. MEDIUM precision.
